temperature_input: daily mean 2m air temperature climatology, degC
season_selection: count all days meeting temperature threshold, not consecutive span; no soil moisture or rainfall selection
snow_treatment: not modelled in this thermal-potential proxy; persistent snow and glacier/host exclusions remain separate, with explicit caveat
metric_transfer: Analyst adaptation, not TREELIM reproduction. Published coupled season boundaries are transferred to temperature-only season.
screen_policy: named component cutoffs only; never infer footprint from combined membership
tree_form: persistent upright trees; not low shrubs, clipped hedges or coppice survival alone
missing: any unknown component makes combined membership unknown; known independent exclusions remain applicable
water_refuges: cannot bypass cold, host or legal screen; conditional water pathway has no combined suitability score or default eligible area
production_binding: Proposed explicit historical pair: Global-AI v3 1970–2000 and CHELSA v2.1 monthly tas 1981–2010 at native support. Baselines differ; not a matched-period climate reconstruction. Policy approval must acknowledge this transfer; a changed/matched-period binding needs re-evaluation.
forbidden_substitutes: soil temperature treated as air temperature
numeric_scope: isolated scoping preview only; no accepted runtime or T4 change
thermal_daily_derivation: Periodic linear interpolation of monthly climatological tas at no-leap month midpoints to365daily means; explicit analyst approximation, not original TREELIM cubic interpolation. Compare monthly-step sensitivity.
snow_caveat: Thermal potential can overstate usable season in persistent snow. Retain existing snow/ice/host exclusions; no claim of establishment or frost tolerance.

excluded_subpractices.parkland_retention: Retention-only management cannot inherit recruitment/establishment screens. Existing assets remain context; renewal requires separate explicit proposal.

scope_missing: Missing or mismatched subpractice/pathway returns outside_review_scope, no score and no climate exclusion.
